title: 卖身契
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, pipa, low strings, growing tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
logline: While the village celebrates its 200,000 yuan, Xiaokang finds the contract binds them to work for the developer forever - and the village turns on him.

clips.summary: At {loc}, the villagers celebrate their money: {cunmin} has never seen so much, {cunfu} jokes about wives, and {dahua} gloats.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 二十万！俺这辈子都没见过这么多钱！
cuts.say: 二十万！俺这辈子……都没见过这么多钱！
cuts.act: 兴奋得声音发颤，乐得合不拢嘴
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {cunmin} slaps the contract against his palm.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 这下你别说讨一个婆娘，就算讨一车都有了！
cuts.say: 这下你别说讨一个婆娘……就算讨一车都有了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 我就说嘛，咱们全村一条心，他敢不给？
cuts.say: 我就说嘛……咱们全村一条心，他敢不给？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, centre frame, the background soft.

clips.summary: {dahua} takes the credit for the extra money; {cunfu} praises her and sneers that {xiaokang}'s schooling has rotted his heart.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 这回要不是我牵头，你们谁能多拿这十五万？
cuts.say: 这回要不是我牵头……你们谁能多拿这十五万？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} jabs a thumb at her own chest.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 还是王大花有本事！咱们村以后就得靠她！
cuts.say: 还是王大花有本事！咱们村以后……就得靠她！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 那个李小康，读书把心都读黑了！
cuts.say: 那个李小康……读书把心都读黑了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {cunfu} jerks her chin toward the edge of the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: At the edge of the crowd, {xiaokang} reads the contract three times and finds a problem no one noticed.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} standing apart at the edge of the crowd at {loc}, holding {contract}.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame.
cuts.action: {xiaokang}'s eyes widen as his finger stops on a clause.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我把补充协议从头到尾看了三遍，发现了一个所有人都没注意到的问题。
cuts.say: 我把补充协议从头到尾看了三遍……发现了一个，所有人都没注意到的问题。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，越说越确定
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} looking down at {contract}.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} pushes into the crowd and says the contract has a problem; {dahua} scoffs; he points to clauses three and five; {cunmin} tells him to spit it out.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 大家先别急着高兴，这合同有问题！
cuts.say: 大家先别急着高兴——这合同有问题！
cuts.act: 挤到人群中间，又急又响
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李家娃子，你又在闹什么？
cuts.say: 李家娃子……你又在闹什么？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 你们看，第三条，还有第五条！
cuts.say: 你们看——第三条，还有第五条！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stabs a finger at the page.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 哎呀，你就直说写的啥！
cuts.say: 哎呀……你就直说写的啥！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} explains that taking the money means working here for good; {cunfu} says paid work is no bad thing.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 意思就是，咱们拿了这二十万，以后就得一直在这干活！
cuts.say: 意思就是……咱们拿了这二十万，以后就得一直在这干活！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 这不是说工资另算吗？干活还给钱，有啥不好的？
cuts.say: 这不是说工资另算吗？干活还给钱……有啥不好的？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} says the contract has no end date: they must work as long as the developer wants.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 不是工资的问题！这合同上没写期限，以甲方实际需求为准！
cuts.say: 不是工资的问题！这合同上没写期限——“以甲方实际需求为准”！
cuts.act: 急得声音发紧，一字一顿念条款
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 就是说他想让你干多久，你就得干多久！
cuts.say: 就是说……他想让你干多久，你就得干多久！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {dahua} mocks that he regrets choosing shares; {cunmin} says he is just bitter about the money.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 哟，我看你是选那什么股选后悔了吧？
cuts.say: 哟……我看你是选那什么股，选后悔了吧？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 人家那是正规大企业，还能把你卖了不成？
cuts.say: 人家那是正规大企业……还能把你卖了不成？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} flicks the contract with her finger.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 你要股票不要钱，当然着急了！我们可是真金白银多拿了二十万！
cuts.say: 你要股票不要钱，当然着急了！我们可是……真金白银多拿了二十万！

cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {cunfu} says he is just jealous; {dahua} asks if his father taught him to tell right from wrong.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 我看他就是眼红！自己选错了，看咱们多拿钱心里不痛快！
cuts.say: 我看他就是眼红！自己选错了……看咱们多拿钱，心里不痛快！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 你怎么连好歹都分不清了？你爸就是这么教育你的？

cuts.action: {dahua} folds her arms, staring him down.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.

clips.summary: {dahua} accuses Xiaokang and his father of wanting to ruin the village; old {erdaye} limps up and pats his arm.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 还是说，你和你爸都想着坏我们一个村的人？
cuts.say: 还是说……你和你爸，都想着坏我们一个村的人？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {xiaokang}'s lips tremble; he grips the contract until it crumples.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at {loc}: {erdaye} limps in on his cane toward {xiaokang}, who stands in the right third.
cuts.action: {erdaye} reaches him and pats his arm gently.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.
cuts.sound: A cane taps on the dirt.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} asks if even {erdaye} doubts him; the old man says nothing is scarier than corn rotting in the field, and sends him home.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: excited chatter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 二大爷，连你也……
cuts.say: 二大爷……连你也……

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 小康啊，大爷穷了一辈子……
cuts.say: 小康啊……大爷穷了一辈子。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 没有什么事，比玉米烂在地里一年没收成更吓人了。
cuts.say: 没有什么事……比玉米烂在地里、一年都没收成，更吓人了。
cuts.act: 苍老的声音里带着心疼

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 你先回去吧，好好想想。
cuts.say: 你先回去吧……好好想想。
